verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents simultaneous multi-user editing of one file with live cursors and instant sync. The nearest items are adjacent features: iOS mirroring of your own edits, browser-based viewing, inspecting and commenting, and starred versions for Library updates. A 2020 community comment only quotes Sketch's promise of real-time collaboration as coming 'soon'.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync
